name: kit-test-backlogrun
commands: git config --global user.name kit-test && git config --global user.email kit-test@example.com

gh label list --limit 100 --json name --jq '.[].name' > "$HOME/labels.txt"; grep -xE 'auto-ok|needs-decision|needs-human-review|already-done|bug' "$HOME/labels.txt"; test "$(grep -cxE 'auto-ok|needs-decision|needs-human-review|already-done|bug' "$HOME/labels.txt")" -eq 5
curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash && export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && claude --version
gh issue create --title 'Add a heading to index.html' --body 'Add an h2 under the h1.' --label auto-ok --label run:lane
timeout 60 pnpm josh backlogrun > "$HOME/backlogrun.out" 2>&1; cat "$HOME/backlogrun.out"; grep -q '^backlogrun: started' "$HOME/backlogrun.out"
for i in $(seq 1 90); do pnpm josh run:event --from 0 | grep -q 'dispatching' && break; sleep 10; done; pnpm josh run:event --from 0 | grep 'dispatching'
for i in $(seq 1 120); do test "$(gh pr list --state all --json number --jq length)" -gt 0 && break; sleep 10; done; pnpm josh run:board --chat
